actions.description: Set every channel amplitude word to 0 (the safe state); it takes no input
actions.name: mute

outputs.description: Amplitude words sent, one per channel
outputs.name: amplitude

adjusts.description: Frequency sent to channels 0 to 3 (one value per channel)
adjusts.name: frequency

adjusts.description: 10-bit amplitude word sent to channels 0 to 3 (0 to 1023 per channel)
adjusts.name: amplitude

adjusts.description: Phase in degrees sent to channels 0 to 3 (0 to 360 per channel)
adjusts.name: phase

facts.text: The AD9959 has 4 channels with modulation and sweep capabilities
set_frequency writes a channel frequency in Hz and selects the channel with ch (0b00 to 0b11)
set_amplitude writes a 10-bit amplitude word with a maximum of 1023
set_phase writes a phase in degrees with a maximum of 360

operator_required.name: frequency
operator_required.reason: the upstream docstring gives max = clock x PLL and min = (clock x PLL) / 2**32, but clock and pll are constructor options of DDS_ESP32 (50E6 and 10 by default); the site states the core clock of its unit and the band it may drive

safe_state.description: all four channel amplitude words at 0
